title: calit2
summary: A small Python data-generation pipeline that preprocesses sensor time-series (temperature/time) data and produces synthetic sequential data using metadata-driven constraints. SDV's PARSynthesizer is run with a Metadata schema and Range constraint to generate synthetic sequences from real sensor data.
